data.body: Investigation complete (debug-everything 2026-05-11): Confirmed design gap — _phase_resolve_threads, _dispatch_fix_agent, and _phase_resolve_conflicts all require _LLM_DISPATCH_CMD/_REMEDIATE_LLM_CMD/_RESOLVE_CONFLICTS_LLM_CMD to be set, and all have CI-environment guards that prevent local dispatch. In a local session these three phases always ESCALATE+exit on first blocker. Script investigation confirms the local-mode loop was removed in S3 (line 940: 'LLM helper was deleted in S3'). Fix requires architectural decision (see ticket description options 1-4). Recommendation: Path 4 (new /dso:finalize-pr skill) is most DSO-native. This fix requires a new sprint/epic — not a hotfix in the current debug-everything session.
